definitions.explanation: A structure built by birds or other animals to hold eggs or young.
A place where someone or something lives or hides.

notes:
{巣|す} refers to structures built by animals for shelter or raising young—nests, hives, webs, dens, etc.

COMMON ANIMAL NESTS:
- ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巣|す}: bird's nest
- ⟦{蜂|はち}→蜂：02242_hachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巣|す}: beehive
- ⟦{蜘蛛|くも}→蜘蛛：02203_kumo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巣|す}: spider web
- ⟦{蟻|あり}→蟻：04291_ari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巣|す}: ant nest

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {巣|す}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to build a nest
- {巣|す}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: to fall from the nest
- ⟦{巣立|すだ}つ→巣立つ：27798_sudatsu⟧: to leave the nest (also figurative)
- {巣|す}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: to return to the nest

FIGURATIVE USAGE (SENSE 2):
{巣|す} can mean "den" or "hideout":
- ⟦{犯罪者|はんざいしゃ}→犯罪者：19219_hanzaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巣|す}: criminals' den
- ⟦{悪|あく}→悪：10459_aku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{巣窟|そうくつ}→巣窟：27820_soukutsu⟧: den of evil

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{巣箱|すばこ}→巣箱：26028_subako⟧: birdhouse
- ⟦{巣穴|すあな}→巣穴：24340_suana⟧: burrow, lair
